nodes.description: Constructor assigns name, symbol, totalSupply, sets owner = msg.sender and mints all tokens.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom: checks allowance, calls ensure(), mutates balanceOf with unchecked arithmetic and increments _onSaleNum.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view whitelist gate: allows owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale addresses, otherwise delegates to condition().
Internal view sale-limit check using _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary data.
Owner-only setter of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum with unchecked multiplications.
Owner-only batch transfer looping over _tos with unchecked multiplication and unchecked balance updates.
Owner-only setter of tradeAddress whitelist.
Internal pure helper computing the Uniswap pair address via CREATE2 address derivation.
Public mapping(address => uint) token balances, mutated in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of allowances, mutated in transferFrom and approve.
Private privileged owner address, used as access-control gate in several functions.
Per-address counter of sales, incremented in transferFrom and read in condition().
Mapping(address=>bool) whitelist consulted by ensure().
Minimum sale amount checked in condition().
Maximum sale amount checked in condition().
Maximum number of sales per address checked in condition().
Whitelisted trade address consulted by ensure(), settable by owner.
Public total supply of the token.
Public token name set in the constructor.
Public token symbol set in the constructor.
Constant Uniswap router address used as a whitelist bypass in ensure().
Constant decimals (18) used in supply and sale-limit scaling.
Caller-controlled address used for owner checks, allowance checks and balance accounting.
Low-level delegatecall in delegate() executing arbitrary external code in this contract's storage context.

Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom.
